cards.name: Ceasefire
cards.officialEffect: If a face-down Defense Position monster or an Effect Monster is on the field: Change all face-down Defense Position monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position (Flip monsters' effects are not activated at this time), also inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each Effect Monster on the field.
adapterBehavior: Requires a live response window, a Set Trap from an earlier turn, and either a face-down Defense Position monster or an Effect Monster on the field.
Cannot chain to a Counter Trap or activate in the Damage Step; respects Jinzo and other continuous Trap policies.
Flips every face-down Defense Position monster on both teams to face-up Defense Position without queuing Flip Effects.
Counts all Effect Monsters after the flip, then inflicts 500 damage per Effect Monster to the opposing shared LP pool.
Ends the duel if that damage reduces the opponent team to zero LP.
Returns the activated Trap to the physical owner's Graveyard, including when controlled by the teammate or stolen by the opposing team.
Preserves physical inventory and the owner's 20–30/Extra 5/3+3/Field Zone/End Phase hand rules.

implementation.integrationBoundary: Pure isolated adapter over TagDuel response windows. Central resolver/Discord integration awaits explicit M61 handoff.

limitations: Ceasefire permanece fora de cardMetadata, cardCertifications, releasedCardIds e allowlist; fixture usa Sakuretsu Armor como Trap habilitada substituta.
O adapter não está ligado ao resolver v9 nem aos comandos Discord; integração central aguarda handoff explícito M61.
A suíte é offline e não valida gateway, permissões, interações ou persistência real do Discord.
Nenhuma certificação, concessão de inventário, alteração de dados persistentes, merge ou deploy.
